data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Live Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Display real-time metrics with Chart.js graphs.
acceptance_criteria: Include a line chart for LLM cost over time.
Use a bar chart for stage completion rates.
Display success rate trends with an area chart.

features.title: Results Visualization
features.description: Show real metrics from recent runs using actual data.
acceptance_criteria: Display actual data from recent Artemis runs.
Ensure data is presented accurately and clearly.
Use Chart.js for all data visualizations.

features.title: Chart.js Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js for data visualization within the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Include Chart.js library in the HTML file.
Use Chart.js to create visualizations for pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
Ensure charts are interactive and visually appealing.

features.title: HTML Presentation Template
features.description: Create a standalone HTML file using existing demos as templates.
acceptance_criteria: Utilize contract_analytics_dashboard.html, lead_opportunity_intelligence_demo.html, and artemis_complete_demo.html as templates.
Ensure the HTML file is standalone with embedded CSS and JavaScript.
Include all necessary resources within the HTML file.

features.title: Feature Metrics Visualization
features.description: Showcase cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning metrics with charts.
acceptance_criteria: Create charts for cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning metrics.
Ensure data is accurate and up-to-date.
Use Chart.js for all visualizations.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Display code quality metrics such as TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Create a radar chart for code quality metrics.
Include metrics for TDD compliance and SOLID principles.
Ensure the chart is easy to interpret.

features.title: Pipeline Visualization
acceptance_criteria: Create a chart representing the 8-stage pipeline.
Ensure each stage is clearly labeled and distinct.
Use Chart.js to enhance the visualization.

features.title: Professional Design
features.description: Implement a professional gradient background and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Apply a gradient background to the presentation.
Ensure transitions between slides are smooth and professional.
Maintain a consistent design theme throughout the presentation.

features.title: HERO: Artemis Introduction
features.description: Introduce Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
acceptance_criteria: Create an introductory slide explaining Artemis.
Highlight key features and capabilities of Artemis.
Ensure the introduction is clear and engaging.

features.title: Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages with a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Create a pie chart to display supervisor integration.
Ensure the chart is clear and informative.
Use Chart.js for the pie chart visualization.

features.title: Auto-advance Slides
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with navigation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Slides should automatically advance after a set duration.
Include navigation controls for manual slide advancement.
Ensure users can pause and resume auto-advance.
